title: Integrate Razorpay payment button and restructure website layout

requirements.summary: Replace UPI payment flow with Razorpay payment button integration
acceptanceCriteria: Razorpay payment button script is loaded asynchronously
Payment button renders with the correct payment_button_id
Previous UPI payment logic is replaced with Razorpay integration
Payment button is visually integrated into the existing CTA sections

file_operations.description: Replace the UPI payment button and modal with Razorpay payment button form. Remove the useUpiPayment hook usage and related state. Add the Razorpay script tag with data-payment_button_id='pl_SIrXp6zPDOixDu' inside a form element. Ensure the script loads asynchronously and is properly integrated into the CTA sections where the Buy Now button currently appears.

Replace the Buy Now button handler with Razorpay payment button integration. Add the Razorpay script form element to render the payment button in the bottom CTA bar instead of triggering the UPI modal.

requirements.summary: Update all pricing displays to ₹299 throughout the website
acceptanceCriteria: All instances of the offer price display ₹299
Any strikethrough or original pricing remains consistent with the new offer price

file_operations.description: Update TECHIFY_CONSTANTS.pricing.offerPrice from its current value to 299. Ensure any related pricing constants (original price, strikethrough price) are adjusted to maintain consistency with the new offer price.
Update all hardcoded price displays in the hero section, pricing cards, and any other sections to reflect ₹299. Ensure the price is consistently formatted across all instances.
Verify the bottom CTA bar displays ₹299 from the updated constant. Ensure the price formatting is consistent with the rest of the site.

requirements.summary: Restructure landing page to move testimonials section below features
acceptanceCriteria: Testimonials section appears after the features section
Content flow follows: Hero → Features → Testimonials → CTA
Visual hierarchy is maintained with proper spacing
Mobile responsiveness is preserved in the new layout

file_operations.description: Reorder the JSX sections in the landing page so that the testimonials/reviews section is rendered after the features section. Ensure the content hierarchy follows: Hero section → Features section → Testimonials section → CTA sections. Maintain proper spacing between sections and verify mobile responsiveness is preserved.

requirements.summary: Enhance overall website design to professional standards with improved typography, spacing, colors, and interactions
acceptanceCriteria: Typography uses a clear hierarchy with consistent font sizes and weights
Spacing follows a consistent scale (e.g., 8px base unit)
Color palette uses professional, harmonious colors with proper contrast
UI elements have refined shadows, borders, and hover states
Overall design feels polished and trustworthy
Layout uses proper white space and breathing room
All sections have cohesive visual treatment

file_operations.description: Enhance the global CSS with professional typography hierarchy using refined font-size scale, consistent spacing utilities based on 8px base unit, and improved base styles for headings, paragraphs, and interactive elements. Add professional utility classes for shadows, borders, and transitions.

Refine the Tailwind theme configuration with a professional color palette featuring harmonious colors with proper contrast ratios. Define consistent spacing scale, refined shadow utilities, professional border radius values, and enhanced animation timings for micro-interactions.

Apply professional design enhancements throughout all sections: improve typography hierarchy with consistent heading sizes and weights, add refined spacing between sections and elements, enhance card designs with professional shadows and borders, add polished hover states and micro-interactions, ensure proper white space and breathing room in the layout, and create cohesive visual treatment across hero, features, testimonials, and CTA sections.

Enhance the bottom CTA bar design with professional styling including refined shadows, improved typography, polished button hover states, and consistent spacing that aligns with the overall design system.
